text:
Alice M: kicking off staged rollout for web-embed v2 -> 10% global, change window 21:30-22:30 PT. tagging for stop/go. will monitor p95, error-rate, and similarity evals. please chime in.
DeployBot: Deploy initiated: deploy_id=deploy_2026_03_21_3412345678; wave=10%; regions=[us,eu,ap]. stage=canary -> 2/3 nodes ok, 1/3 warming. logs: https://deploys.internal/deploy_2026_03_21_3412345678
Ben P: pinging metrics now. any canary alerts configured?
Carla R: pulling canary slice. initial p95 (token gen) +12% in eu vs baseline, us +4%. error-rate eu 0.9% (baseline 0.2%). similarity drift on eval set: eu median down 0.7% absolute. still investigating.
Dave L: hmm sounds regional. Are we sure it's model weights mismatch or infra flakiness?
Carla R: checked hashes and weights are identical across regions. infra traces show increased KV cache miss rate in eu.
Infra Oncall: seeing repeated kvcache eviction churn on eu-west-1 GPU hosts around the time of the rollout: "kvcache_reclaim_count" spiked. OOMs on a few pods then restarted. stack: redis-kv -> svc proxy -> runtime.
Alice M: ok if EU is flaking we should avoid global rollback. proposal: pause global ramp, hold US at 10% (keep traffic), scale EU back to 5% or remove EU from wave. quick vote: stop globally / hold-and-segment / rollback entirely?
Ben P: +1 hold-and-segment. keep US live so customers not impacted, isolate EU.
Carla R: +1. also suggest pin v1 for new traffic in eu while we triage.
DeployBot: Traffic shift command executed: deploy_2026_03_21_3412345678 -> regions: us=10%, eu=5%, ap=0% (ap drained). Ops note: change window still open until 22:30 PT.
Dave L: action items: 1) revert AP (already drained) 2) scale kv cache memory on eu hosts by +20% (infra) 3) pin fallback model in eu routes to web-embed v1. I'll run the rollout pin now.
Infra Oncall: scaling kv cache on eu now: kubectl patch sts web-embed-kvcache-eu -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kvcache","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"6Gi"},"requests":{"memory":"4Gi"}}}]}}}}'  -> rolling update started.
Alice M: Carla, can you run a focused sim on the eu slice (1000 queries) to validate similarity after kvcache scale completes? Put results in the thread.
Carla R: running sim now. quick summary 200/1000 failed due to backend 502s during pod restarts; re-running post-scale.
Ben P: from product side, any urgent customer-facing comms needed? current impact in EU small % of customers, degradations mostly latency/errors on long sequences.
Alice M: hold on comms until we confirm rollback/pin. prefer to avoid public note if we can fix within window.
DeployBot: Rollout pin applied: routes/eu -> pinned_model=web-embed-v1 (sticky) for new sessions. TTL=30m.
Dave L: OK. interim decision: do not rollback globally. Hold at segmented levels: us stays 10%, eu pinned to v1 for new sessions and limited to 5% of legacy traffic, ap kept drained. Re-evaluate at +20m. If errors remain >0.5% in eu then rollback eu to v1 fully.
Carla R: post-scale re-run: similarity delta now within 0.2% of baseline, p95 improved ~6% but still +6% vs baseline. errors dropped to 0.25%. looks much better.
Ben P: thumbs up from product. recommend continue monitoring and proceed with cautious ramp in US if stable.
Alice M: vote tally: Ben +1, Carla +1, Dave +1, Infra Oncall neutral. consensus=hold-and-segment with eu pin. We'll check again in 18 minutes.
Infra Oncall: will keep extra kvcache headroom and watch restarts. alert thresholds adjusted: eu errors notify at 0.4%.
DeployBot: Canary progress: deploy_2026_03_21_3412345678 -> status=paused (manual hold), regions={us:10%, eu:5% pinned->v1 fallback paths, ap:0%}, note=awaiting manual re-check at 3412345788.
Alice M: thanks all. if eu stays stable we can resume ap->5% and then unify ramp. if it regresses we'll do region-specific rollback rather than global. leaving thread open for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
Carla R: will post detailed post-scale metrics once window closes.
Dave L: I'll prepare a rollback playbook snippet in case: ```# rollback eu
kubectl set image deploy/web-embed eu=web-embed:v1
trafficctl set region eu 0 -> then set us to 10% etc.
```
Ben P: noted. thanks team.
Alice M: last check at 3412345690 -> currently stable, holding. final sign-off in 10m unless new alerts. :eyes:
